# TubesZB 2026.10.29.2

Prerelease for testing socket accounting and configuration cleanup following 2026.10.29.1.

- Removed the deprecated `stream_server.buffer_size` setting from the remaining hardware profiles. UART `rx_buffer_size` settings are unchanged.
- Added socket declarations for radio firmware downloads, the shared HTTP transport and the background connectivity probe, including compatibility accounting for older ESPHome versions.
- Removed the fixed 16-socket limit so ESPHome can calculate capacity from the enabled components.

Use the image for your exact hardware model: `.ota.bin` for a device OTA update or `.factory.bin` for a serial/USB installation with https://web.esphome.io.

See [2026.10.29.1](https://github.com/tube0013/TubesZB-ESPHome-Builder/releases/tag/2026.10.29.1) for the web interface, saved network settings and upgrade information. Existing firmware with a compiled-in static IP starts on DHCP on its first upgrade to this firmware; configure and confirm the desired static address in **Network**.
